content.short: Handshake is a decentralized naming and certificate authority with an experimental peer-to-peer root naming system.
content.description: Handshake is a decentralized, permissionless naming protocol in which each participating node is responsible for validating and maintaining the root DNS naming zone. By distributing authority across peers, it eliminates a single centralized control point and fosters collective governance over the top-level namespace. The protocol aims to provide an alternative to traditional Certificate Authorities and conventional naming systems, offering a peer-driven approach to secure, verifiable domain naming without relying on centralized intermediaries.
